plan_title: Para o Brasil Vencer o Atraso (TSE, 76 pages, 9 axes)

policies.title: Federal spending cut of about 1.5% of GDP and new fiscal rules
policies.description: Cut federal spending by about 1.5% of GDP (R$ 190 billion): ministries' discretionary spending, pensions and disability benefits (BPC) adjusted by inflation only instead of following the minimum wage's real gains, and health and education spending floors adjusted by inflation only. New fiscal rules: primary-surplus targets, limits on subsidized credit and a cap on discretionary spending of the three branches.
policies.title_pt: Corte de gastos de cerca de 1,5% do PIB e novas regras fiscais

policies.title: Merge or close at least ten ministries
policies.description: Merge or close at least ten ministries and cut appointed positions and administrative costs.
policies.title_pt: Fundir ou extinguir ao menos dez ministérios

policies.title: Lower taxes on consumption, fuel and electricity
policies.description: Lower the dual VAT rate and revise the 2023 tax reform; cut taxes on electricity and fuels.
policies.title_pt: Reduzir impostos sobre consumo, combustíveis e energia

policies.title: Resume privatizations
policies.description: Restart the federal privatization program, deciding company by company.

policies.title: R$ 900 billion infrastructure program
policies.description: R$ 900 billion of infrastructure investment over four years, mostly through concessions and private partnerships; the development bank refocused on infrastructure, critical minerals, energy and data centers.
policies.title_pt: Programa de R$ 900 bilhões em infraestrutura

policies.title: Keep the current social programs
policies.description: Keep the existing cash-transfer and social programs.

policies.title: Criminal factions as terrorist groups; new federal prisons
policies.description: Classify criminal factions as terrorist organizations in law and build five new federal maximum-security prisons.
policies.title_pt: Facções como organizações terroristas; novos presídios federais

policies.title: Lower the age of criminal responsibility
policies.description: Constitutional amendment lowering it from 18 to 16, and to 14 for heinous crimes such as murder, rape and drug trafficking.

policies.title: Longer and stricter criminal penalties
policies.description: Chemical castration for rapists, no sentence progression for femicide, longer penalties for cell-phone theft.

policies.title: Restrict the powers of the Supreme Court
policies.description: Constitutional amendment restricting single-justice rulings and the scope of the Supreme Court.

policies.title: End presidential re-election
policies.description: Constitutional amendment ending re-election for president.

policies.title: Digital economy and data centers
policies.description: Digitize public services and attract data-center and critical-mineral investment.

policies.title: Closer ties with the US, Argentina and Israel
policies.description: Give priority to relations with the US, Argentina and Israel while keeping trade with China and other partners.
policies.title_pt: Aproximação com EUA, Argentina e Israel

policies.title: Zero illegal deforestation by 2029 through monitoring
policies.title_pt: Desmatamento ilegal zero até 2029 com monitoramento
policies.description: Satellites, artificial intelligence and coordination between agencies to detect and police illegal deforestation, with priority for the Amazon.

policies.title: Looser environmental licensing
policies.description: Simplify environmental licensing so farmers, ranchers and miners can expand activities and mining more easily.

policies.title: Lower labor costs
policies.description: Gradually lower payroll costs without removing labor rights; cheaper contracts for first jobs (ages 18-24) and for workers over 50.

policies.title: Daycare and school vouchers
policies.description: Vouchers for accredited private daycare and schools when public places run out.

policies.title: Student loans repaid as a share of income
policies.description: Replace student loans with repayment tied to the graduate's future income.
policies.title_pt: Crédito estudantil pago conforme a renda

policies.title: Anti-fraud reviews of social-security benefits
policies.description: Anti-fraud checks and benefit reviews at the national social-security institute; new rules for payroll loans to retirees.
policies.title_pt: Combate a fraudes em benefícios do INSS
